claim: More physical lines increase Tag lookup capacity or permit address hits on unmapped retained physical generations.
evidence: m_tags=logical_sets*logical_ways=512 unchanged; find_tag searches this table only. m_phys protects generations/Refs; an unmapped retained line is not searched by address.
counterexample_or_limit: Both programs gain valid-hit events while retaining512 lookup entries; event increase does not identify a larger address namespace.
discriminating_observation: No new observation needed to reject capacity equivalence. New Tag geometry/reclaim semantics would be a separate mechanism/identity and remain CPU-only design here.

claim: The physical768 response is caused specifically by removal of physical-full critical stalls.
evidence: Only physical640->768 changes. MVT and BICG replace fewer Tags and have fewer deferred/final-Ref reclamations. Source physical-full access returns NO_FREE_LINE without freeing protected generations.
counterexample_or_limit: OO no_free_physical_events getter exists but is not exported by consumed OO stdout/CSV. Terminal gauge and all64SM mean cannot measure full episodes or critical stall duration. BICG regresses despite fewer lower requests.
discriminating_observation: Versioned per-SM physical availability/Refcount/Tag mapping histograms and per-instruction failed-allocation reason/time, retaining generation/PIB identity.

claim: Lower OO misses or fewer Tag evictions necessarily reduce cycles and DRAM demand.
evidence: MVT lower requests-43.9817%,DRAM reads-2.82558%,cycles-11.7555%; BICG lower requests-37.0988%,DRAM reads+16.4386%,cycles+7.6938%.
counterexample_or_limit: Read miss fraction is conditional on filtered lower demand: its rise alone may be denominator filtering. BICG absolute read growth is real; current counters do not identify lower address subset, ordering, cache history or critical latency.
discriminating_observation: Read-only accepted family endpoint comparisons now; future origin-linked lower address/arrival/response records and L2 hit/miss classification to separate filtering/order/history.

claim: BICG regression reflects a general increase in overall L2 bank-count imbalance.
evidence: BICG K2 explicit40-L2-bank miss32B interval CV decreases0.9462922098->0.9249760944, although absolute DRAM and retry counts rise.
counterexample_or_limit: Population CV is relative across full-phase counts, includes zero banks, and is not DRAM-bank mapping or short-time queue pressure. Lower CV cannot rule out larger absolute busiest-bank load or local hotspots.
discriminating_observation: Read-only compact CSV temporal counts at exact cycle/instruction snapshots; if unresolved, per-bank queue/service time and origin-linked critical dependencies in separately approved instrumentation.

claim: The response is explained by uniform improvement/worsening of post-ready completion or writeback.
evidence: MVT K1 postready sum grows while cycles fall; BICG K2 WB-wait sum falls while cycles rise. App postready+0.0160%/+0.7303%,app WB sum-54.6747%/-48.1387%. Source finite create/inject/retire widths do not change.
counterexample_or_limit: Service sums overlap SMs/instructions and use retired-item windows. They do not bound critical-path contributions, and a minority critical instruction could behave differently.
discriminating_observation: Read-only retired/sample denominators and exact phase deltas; future readiness-to-collect-to-WB-to-dependent-use timestamps linked by UID/generation.

claim: Higher mean PIB occupancy proves PIB-full stalls or predicts Physical?PIB combination speedup.
evidence: All64SM mean PIB rises in MVT K1 and BICG K2. Actual OO PIB128 and lower-create queue128 remain fixed for physical-only runs. PIB192 changes both bounds, not isolated PIB depth.
counterexample_or_limit: Both have0 explicitly printed lower-create-queue-full and lower-cap-full events; OO PIB-full event/time and active-SM peaks are unavailable. Mean occupancy is not saturation; both signs of cycle response exist.
discriminating_observation: Consume existing authorized PIB192 and physical1024 strictly closed results without reselecting workloads; real combination J remains null until all same-input terms are accepted under separate execution authority.

claim: Candidate row-strided reuse pattern or phase order uniquely explains opposite MVT/BICG responses.
evidence: Inspected dad09c source has MVT row-strided first and BICG row-strided second; actual slow kernels share71380992instructions but are distinct inputSHA/programs.
counterexample_or_limit: Capture-source/ELF binding and numeric/coherence remain unresolved; initial states/addresses and interleavings are not controlled as a single phase-order intervention. Static sequential-address reuse is not cache hit/MSHR merge.
discriminating_observation: Read-only exact trace/source binding evidence if already available; future matched phase-state or address-origin observation only under an independent, explicit contract.

claim: Physical expansion or greater resources must improve all programs; zeros prove no pressure or compute-bound behavior.
evidence: 2DCONV/GEMM physical768/1024 exact-cycle and known-additive zeros; vectorAdd all4families exact zero with0 OO valid/pending hits. GEMM0DRAM under this capture,2DCONV nonzeroDRAM.
counterexample_or_limit: No universal positive effect; nonzero evictions/deferred lifetimes/finite-service sums can coexist with zero response. L2 HtoD prefill and limited observation scope prohibit a compute-bound or real-GPU claim.
discriminating_observation: Keep these fixed negative/zero controls in all lawful comparisons; no best-case workload selection.
